topic: Nintendo Started as a Playing Card Company in 1889
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know Nintendo is 135 Years Old? 🎮

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Nintendo was founded in 1889 in Kyoto, Japan, as a handmade hanafuda (flower card) company. Before video games, they tried taxi services, love hotels, and instant rice.
